assignments.title: Python Math Functions - Circle and Sphere
assignments.description:
# Mathematical Functions Assignment

In this assignment, you'll implement functions to calculate geometric properties.

## Formulas You'll Need

### Circle Area
The area of a circle with radius $r$ is:
$$A_{circle} = \pi r^2$$

### Sphere Volume
The volume of a sphere with radius $r$ is:
$$V_{sphere} = \frac{4}{3}\pi r^3$$

### Sphere Surface Area
$$A_{sphere} = 4\pi r^2$$

## Requirements
- Use $\pi \approx 3.14159$
- Round results to 2 decimal places
- Handle edge cases where $r \leq 0$

questions.title: Calculate Circle Area
questions.description:

**Formula:** $A = \pi r^2$

**Example:**

**Constraints:**
- Return `0` if $r \leq 0$

questions.title: Calculate Sphere Volume

**Formula:** $$V = \frac{4}{3}\pi r^3$$

**Example:**
- Input: `r = 3`
- Output: `113.10`

assignments.title: Calculus Functions - Derivatives and Integrals
assignments.description:
# Calculus Assignment

## Overview
Implement numerical methods for calculus operations.

## Background

### Derivative Definition
The derivative of a function $f(x)$ at point $x$ is:
$$f'(x) = \lim_{h \to 0} \frac{f(x+h) - f(x)}{h}$$

### Definite Integral
The definite integral from $a$ to $b$:
$$\int_a^b f(x) dx$$

### Power Rule
For $f(x) = x^n$:
$$\frac{d}{dx}[x^n] = nx^{n-1}$$

## Task
Implement numerical approximations using the formulas above.

questions.title: Numerical Derivative
questions.description:
Implement `derivative(f, x, h=0.0001)` using the difference quotient.

**Formula:**
$$f'(x) \approx \frac{f(x+h) - f(x)}{h}$$

where $h$ is a small value (default: $0.0001$)

**Example:**
For $f(x) = x^2$ at $x = 3$:
- Expected: $f'(3) = 6$

questions.title: Trapezoidal Rule Integration
questions.description:
Implement `integrate(f, a, b, n=1000)` using the trapezoidal rule.

**Formula:**
$$\int_a^b f(x) dx \approx \frac{b-a}{2n} \sum_{i=0}^{n-1} [f(x_i) + f(x_{i+1})]$$

where $x_i = a + i\cdot\frac{b-a}{n}$

**Example:**
For $\int_0^1 x^2 dx$:
- Expected: $\frac{1}{3} \approx 0.333$

assignments.description:
# Matrix Operations Assignment

## Matrix Basics

### Matrix Multiplication
For matrices $A$ (size $m \times n$) and $B$ (size $n \times p$):
$$(AB)_{ij} = \sum_{k=1}^{n} A_{ik} B_{kj}$$

### Example
$$A = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 2 \\ 3 & 4 \end{pmatrix}, \quad B = \begin{pmatrix} 5 & 6 \\ 7 & 8 \end{pmatrix}$$

$$AB = \begin{pmatrix} 19 & 22 \\ 43 & 50 \end{pmatrix}$$

### Determinant (2×2)
For a $2 \times 2$ matrix:
$$\det(A) = \begin{vmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{vmatrix} = ad - bc$$

## Implementation
Implement these operations using Python lists.

assignments.title: Statistics - Mean, Variance, and Standard Deviation
assignments.description:
# Statistical Measures

## Formulas

### Mean (Average)
For a dataset $x_1, x_2, ..., x_n$:
$$\mu = \bar{x} = \frac{1}{n} \sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i$$

### Variance
Measure of spread:
$$\sigma^2 = \frac{1}{n} \sum_{i=1}^{n} (x_i - \mu)^2$$

### Standard Deviation
Square root of variance:
$$\sigma = \sqrt{\sigma^2} = \sqrt{\frac{1}{n} \sum_{i=1}^{n} (x_i - \mu)^2}$$

## Notes
- $\mu$ (mu) represents the mean
- $\sigma$ (sigma) represents standard deviation
- $\sigma^2$ represents variance
- Use population formulas (divide by $n$, not $n-1$)

assignments.title: Physics - Kinematics Equations
assignments.description:
# Kinematics Assignment

## Motion Equations

### Velocity
Velocity is the rate of change of position:
$$v = \frac{dx}{dt}$$

For constant acceleration:
$$v = v_0 + at$$

where:
- $v$ = final velocity
- $v_0$ = initial velocity  
- $a$ = acceleration
- $t$ = time

### Position with Constant Acceleration
$$x = x_0 + v_0 t + \frac{1}{2}at^2$$

where $x_0$ is initial position

### Velocity-Displacement Equation
$$v^2 = v_0^2 + 2a(x - x_0)$$

## Constants
- Gravity: $g = 9.8 \text{ m/s}^2$ (downward)
- Use SI units (meters, seconds)

questions.title: Final Velocity
questions.description:
Calculate final velocity using $v = v_0 + at$

**Parameters:**
- `v0`: initial velocity (m/s)
- `a`: acceleration (m/s²)
- `t`: time (s)

**Example:**
A car accelerates from rest at $2 \text{ m/s}^2$ for $5 \text{ s}$:
- $v_0 = 0$, $a = 2$, $t = 5$
- $v = 0 + 2(5) = 10 \text{ m/s}$

questions.title: Position with Acceleration
questions.description:
Calculate position using:
$$x = x_0 + v_0 t + \frac{1}{2}at^2$$

**Parameters:**
- `x0`: initial position (m)
- `v0`: initial velocity (m/s)
- `a`: acceleration (m/s²)
- `t`: time (s)

**Example - Free Fall:**
Drop object from $h = 100 \text{ m}$:
- $x_0 = 100$, $v_0 = 0$, $a = -9.8$, $t = 2$
- $x = 100 + 0(2) + \frac{1}{2}(-9.8)(2)^2 = 80.4 \text{ m}$

assignments.title: Quadratic Equations and Roots
assignments.description:
# Solving Quadratic Equations

## Standard Form
$$ax^2 + bx + c = 0$$

where $a \neq 0$

## Quadratic Formula
The solutions are:
$$x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2-4ac}}{2a}$$

## Discriminant
The discriminant $\Delta$ determines the nature of roots:
$$\Delta = b^2 - 4ac$$

### Cases:
- $\Delta > 0$: Two distinct real roots
- $\Delta = 0$: One repeated real root  
- $\Delta < 0$: Two complex conjugate roots

## Examples

### Example 1: $x^2 - 5x + 6 = 0$
- $a=1, b=-5, c=6$
- $\Delta = 25 - 24 = 1 > 0$
- Roots: $x = 2$ and $x = 3$

### Example 2: $x^2 - 4x + 4 = 0$  
- $\Delta = 16 - 16 = 0$
- Root: $x = 2$ (repeated)
